label: ⏳ Augmented Dickey-Fuller
description: Unit-root test. H0: series has a unit root (= non-stationary). Rejecting H0 (small p-value) means the series is stationary. Required check before ARIMA — non-stationary inputs need differencing first.

regression.label: Trend regression
regression.help: c = constant; ct = constant + linear trend; ctt = + quadratic; n = no constant.
